items.title: Rick Margitza interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 22, 2024
items.q: His brother Louis lives in Paris... I became friends with Francois.

ctx.x: What prompted you to relocate to Paris?

Well I was living in New York — well so I lived, at this point I was in New Orleans and then when the Blue Note thing happened and Miles happened it was 1989 or so, and I always wanted to move to New York. So I moved to New York around ’89 and was there for about ten years. And at that point you know in New York there still is not — you know you’re doing these little gigs but you’re not making a lot of money and since I was kind of new on the scene I got calls to come over to Europe to do jazz festivals, and…
